applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia-Peru Trade Promotion Agreement with the United States

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Article 18 of Law 2010 of 2019 and Resolución DIAN 2801 of 2020 establish the mandatory Beneficial Owner Registry (UBO). AML/CFT framework includes Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF), Law 1121 of 2006, Law 1474 of 2011, Law 1762 of 2015, Decreto 1081 of 2015, Decreto 830 of 2020, and Circular Básica Jurídica (Circular Externa 029 de 2014) issued by the Superintendencia de Sociedades. For pharmaceutical API wholesale, additional compliance standards arise under Ley 2004 de 2019 and Decreto 677 de 1995 (medicine controls), as well as investment screening regulations under Decreto 985 de 2021.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Legal Existence and Corporate Representation of Foreign Parent Entity (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal de la Matriz)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of jurisdiction of origin (e.g., Companies House, Aranzadi Mercantile, US Secretary of State)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (all jurisdictions party to the 1961 Hague Convention) OR Consular Legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Incorporation Deed and Amended By-Laws of Foreign Parent Entity (Escritura de Constitución y Estatutos Vigentes)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public and competent corporate registry of jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization plus sworn translation into Spanish

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney granted to Colombian legal representatives (Poder Especial)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization, followed by registration with the Cámara de Comercio

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn Affidavit of Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (Ubicación del Beneficiario Final)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sole shareholder or authorized corporate representative before Colombian notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized before Notario Público in Colombia; no apostille required if executed in Colombia

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, legal representatives, and ultimate beneficial owners against the OFAC/OFAC SDN list, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, European Union Consolidated Sanctions List, Colombia's own 'Consejo Nacional de Política Criminal' and UIAF restrictive lists, the U.S. Patriot Act watchlist, and global PEP databases. Enhanced due diligence applies to politically exposed persons (PEPs), non-residents from FATF high-risk jurisdictions, and any transaction involving countries subject to OFAC comprehensive sanctions. All results must be filed in the AML compliance file in accordance with Circular Básica Jurídica.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) operated by the Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá and other regional chambers
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be in Spanish or contain permitted Latin characters. If the elected name in English or another language uses transliteration, it must be adapted to Spanish phonetics without altering the identity. The name must comply with the principle of homogeneity when using a change of control percentage from the 'INDUCOM' system. No numerals or punctuation are allowed unless forming part of the name. The term 'S.A.S.' must appear immediately after the chosen corporate denomination for Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Institutional terms: 'Banco', 'Banco de la República', 'Fondo de Garantías', 'Superintendencia Financiera'
Misleading terms that falsely indicate public status or concession
Terms typically associated with financial institutions, insurance, vedoría pública, or activities requiring special government authorizations
Terms that express a wider geographical scope than the intended activity (e.g., 'Andina', 'Americana') without prior ministerial approval
Names already registered or reserved in the same or similar trade area businesses
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Cámara de Comercio rejects a name application, the applicant may file a formal written appeal (recurso de reposición) with the same Cámara within 10 business days of notification. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may raise a secondary appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Sociedades. For reservations lapsed after 30 days, a new homonymous-lookup request must be filed at the same registry counter and the name released into the queue can be re-reserved if still available.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are accepted for the formal registered address of an S.A.S. (sede principal) only for purposes of receiving official correspondence and registral notifications. However, for the wholesale distribution of active pharmaceutical ingredients, a physical operating warehouse or licensed storage facility must be secured in Colombia prior to obtaining the sanitary license from INVIMA. The registered office may be administrative-only if no physical inventory is stored in that location, but the pharmaceutical license requires an active operational address.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Registry tariff per statutory fee schedule (Tarifa no. 01)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff (Decreto 019 de 2012, Tarifa no. 6)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal post-registration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Subdirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Tax administration fee on an annual filing basis

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory health licensing tariff according to INVIMA fee rates

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 98-110, 353-356; Law 1258 of 2008, Articles 1-46 (S.A.S. regime)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) under the Registro Único Empresarial (RUE) system
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation document) submitted for Mercantile Registry inscription
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum legal capital for S.A.S.; at least one share must be subscribed and paid in cash, goods, or services. Cash payments require at least 20% of subscribed capital to be paid at incorporation, with the balance payable within one year. No escrow account requirement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION No. 1 OF THE FOUNDING BOARD OF SHAREHOLDERS OF [COMPANY NAME] S.A.S. On this date, the founding shareholders unanimously resolve: (1) To approve the share subscription of all shares of the authorized subscribed capital; (2) To adopt the company's registered office located at [Address], Bogotá, Colombia, and file same before the Chamber of Commerce; (3) To appoint [Name] as Representative and each of [Names] as Audit Officer and Compliance Officer; (4) To authorize the attorney-in-fact to execute all public registration formalities, obtain the National Tax Registry (RUT), and open a bank account; (5) To ratify all prior acts and order registration of this resolution in the corporate minute book.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (Registro Único Empresarial - RUE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Search and reserve the proposed corporate name at the Chamber of Commerce's online portal (https://www.ccb.org.co). Submit three name alternatives and obtain a Certificate of Homonymy (Certificado de Homonimia). The reservation is valid for 30 business days and must be included in the incorporation document.
required_dossiers: Personal identification of each founding shareholder (cédula or passport)
Proof of legal status if a shareholder is a legal entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is rejected for homonymy, resubmit alternative names within the reservation window or file an administrative reconsideration request at the same Chamber.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Incorporation Document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Chamber of Commerce (private document) or Notary Public if real property is contributed
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución in Spanish, setting out company name, domicile, purpose, capital description, board composition, and representation. Execute the document before a notary only when contributing real estate; if cash-only, execute privately with signatures authenticated for legalization. Include the by-laws (estatutos) and terms of the license required for pharmaceuticals.
required_dossiers: Identification cards (cédula / passport) of all shareholders
List of directors and officers with their written acceptance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or Chamber observes defects, correct the by-laws and re-execute; missing shareholder signatures require a new execution with all parties present.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction in the registered office (e.g., CCB for Bogotá)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed incorporation document plus supporting forms on the Chamber's electronic portal. Pay the registration tariff calculated on subscribed capital. Receive the Commercial Registry Certificate (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal) and the provisional RUT draft.
required_dossiers: Certificate of capital pay-in (bank receipt or cashier's cheque if paid in cash)
Formulario de registro with Chamber fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is queried, complete the digital form within 5 business days; a second query may require physical administrative review and payment of a late fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the provisional RUT generated at registration, complete the RUT wizard on DIAN's online tax portal (www.dian.gov.co), obtain the definitive RUT, enroll in the sales tax (IVA) regime, and request the digital certificate (firma) for electronic invoicing.
required_dossiers: Active email address for DIAN notifications
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the registered address or legal type, correct the registration form online and present the physical file at the territorial DIAN office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal ICA (Industry and Commerce Tax) Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Treasury (Secretaría de Hacienda) of the local district or municipality
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the ICA registration form in the municipal online tax system, declaring activity code 4649 (wholesale of pharmaceutical products) and expected gross revenue for the upcoming fiscal year. Obtain the ICA Certificate and withholding tax certificate if the company is classified as a large taxpayer.
required_dossiers: Lease contract of registered office or property title
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the classification code is contested, file a reconsideration brief to the local tax office and adjust the taxpayer's activities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Security and Labor Registry (Obligatory Pre-Operation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: ARL, EPS and Pension Fund of the workers; Ministry of Labour via PILA
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company as an employer with Colombian pension, health, and ARL entities through the Unified Payment System (PILA) portal. Enroll workers and obtain occupational health documentation. This is a condition precedent for issuing payroll before operations.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the PILA registration fails, correct worker data and revalidate through PILA; for ARL refusal due to activity class, provide evidence of training from a prevention provider.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: INVIMA (Instituto Nacional de Vigilancia de Medicamentos y Alimentos)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorización Sanitaria for the wholesale distribution of active pharmaceutical ingredients under Decree 2200 of 2005 and Resolution 1229 of 2013

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) or the regional environmental authority (CAR) depending on location
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt for pure wholesale distribution without manufacturing or chemical processing; if pharmaceutical manufacturing or large-scale storage is added, a full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) may be required under Decree 1076 of 2015.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must comply with Resolution 631 of 2015 (maximum permissible limits per activity). Hazardous wastes must be managed under Decree 4741 of 2005. VOC emissions, if any storage tank vents exist, must comply with Resolution 909 of 2008, with thresholds generally set at 0.5 kg/h maximum for volatile compounds in industrial facilities.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the local Fire Department (Bomberos), structural load clearance from a certified engineer/firm for warehouse shelving and storage areas, and occupational health clearance from the ARL (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales) covering workplace safety, handling of hazardous chemicals, manual-load limits, and ventilation requirements.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional services via the MUISCA platform; foreign-trade procedures via the VUCE single window (vuce.gov.co).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Procedure for obtaining the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) and RUT (Registro Único Tributario): (1) The Colombian S.A.S. is incorporated by notarized deed or private document registered in the Cámara de Comercio, and the NIT is assigned automatically upon Chamber registration; (2) The S.A.S. must complete or update its RUT electronically through DIAN's website, activating status as 'Responsable de IVA – Régimen Común' and any applicable tax classification (e.g., great taxpayer) and foreign-trade profile; (3) A non-resident foreign entity without a Colombian permanent establishment must appoint a local attorney-in-fact with a notarized and apostilled power of attorney and submit the RUT form plus apostilled certificate of incorporation to DIAN to obtain a NIT for Colombian-source income and withholding purposes; (4) The foreign shareholder(s) of the S.A.S. must be registered in the company's RUT and in the shareholding annex for dividend and transfer-pricing reporting; (5) Issuance of a DIAN digital fiscal certificate (certificado digital fiscal) and activation of electronic-invoice authorization in MUISCA complete the operational tax onboarding.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. A Colombian S.A.S. is a separate tax-resident corporation with no pass-through treatment; it is subject to national corporate income tax on worldwide income. Territorial-scope rules apply to non-residents: they are taxed only on Colombian-source income. Free-zone (Zona Franca) status is optional and is not a default classification.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No U.S.-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists under Colombian law. Available statutory mechanisms include: (i) the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) for qualifying small taxpayers with gross revenues ≤ COP 3.5 billion, subject to activity and shareholding exclusions; (ii) optional consolidated corporate income tax filing for business groups under common economic control (ET Article 10); (iii) OECD-aligned CFC, permanent-establishment, and transfer-pricing rules which apply mandatorily rather than by election; (iv) a conditional 0% VAT treatment for qualifying export of services under ET Article 481, formalized through the RUT and export-of-services declaration rather than a discretionary election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA – Impuesto sobre las Ventas (national value-added tax administered by DIAN; municipalities may also levy the ICA industry-and-commerce tax outside the VAT system).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold for corporate entities: an S.A.S. is automatically a VAT-responsible 'régimen común' taxpayer from incorporation and must register with DIAN in the RUT and charge IVA on taxable supplies at the applicable rate. The 3,500 UVT threshold (approximately COP 164.7 million for tax year 2024) applies only to natural persons eligible for 'no responsable de IVA' status; corporate entities cannot use this threshold to avoid VAT registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica de Venta – FEV) on the DIAN MUISCA platform. All invoices must be issued in XML and transmitted through DIAN web services (API) with pre-validation (validación previa) for the vast majority of taxpayers, functioning as fiscal clearance. Each invoice embeds a unique digital validation code (CUFE – Código Único de Facturación Electrónica; CUDE for credit/debit notes) that acts as a digital stamp. Taxpayers must use DIAN-certified billing software or DIAN's free web tool and deliver a PDF/A-3 or XML copy to the buyer. Non-transmitted or non-validated invoices are legally invalid and trigger fines under ET Article 652-14.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Physical exports of goods, including exported API batches, are taxed at 0% IVA under ET Articles 481-482 provided: (i) the goods physically leave Colombian customs territory and the S.A.S. is the exporter of record; (ii) an accepted export declaration (DEX) is filed through customs; (iii) the commercial invoice is issued as an export invoice with a 0% IVA statement; and (iv) foreign-currency proceeds are channeled through the Colombian foreign-exchange market and repatriated within the statutory term. Qualifying services to non-residents with effect or use abroad (e.g., software development, technical support, and certain digital services) may also qualify as export of services under ET Article 481 upon filing the export-of-services declaration in the RUT and satisfying the invoicing and FX-repatriation conditions.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración de Exportación (DEX) duly accepted by DIAN customs (transmitted through the VUCE platform)
Bill of Lading (maritime) or Air Waybill (air) evidencing exportation from Colombian customs territory
Export commercial invoice annotated with the 0% IVA export statement
Certificado de Liquidación de Divisas (foreign-exchange settlement certificate) issued by the local authorized intermediary bank
INVIMA sanitary authorization, export certificate, or free-sale certificate for the pharmaceutical API consignment
Apostilled certificate of origin or other export-assist registry documents, when applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If any export condition is missing or not substantiated, DIAN may reclassify the transaction as a domestic taxable sale and assess 19% IVA retroactively, plus moratory interest at the legal rate and an omission/inaccuracy penalty of up to 200% of the tax difference under ET Article 647. Invalid or untransmitted electronic invoices carry additional fines under ET Article 652-14. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within the 180-day FX deadline breaches the Colombian foreign-exchange regime and can trigger fines by DIAN and Banco de la República and loss of zero-rating. DIAN has a 5-year statute of limitations from the tax-return due date (extended up to 10 years for non-filing) to claw back improperly claimed credits or zero-rated benefits. Fraudulent export zero-rating claims or false documentation can also lead to criminal tax fraud charges under Law 599/2000 as amended by Law 1943/2018, carrying imprisonment of 48 to 108 months, in addition to customs crimes.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia), acting as the monetary and exchange authority together with the Junta Directiva del Banco de la República and the Comisión de Cambios Internacionales, pursuant to Law 9 of 1991, the Estatuto Cambiario, and External Resolution No. 1 of 2018, as amended. Foreign exchange operations are channelled exclusively through Authorized Foreign Exchange Intermediaries (Bancos Comerciales Autorizados), cargo exchange houses, and other entities expressly authorized by the Banco de la República.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian Peso (COP) operates under a free-floating managed exchange-rate regime with full current-account convertibility for bona fide trade in goods and services, subject to documentary declaration and channeling requirements. Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment (FDI), equity contributions, capital repatriation, and profit remittances, are free but must be registered with the Banco de la República through an Authorized Foreign Exchange Intermediary before or within the applicable registration window. Profit remittances are permitted once Colombian corporate annual financial statements have been approved and taxes have been paid, provided that the foreign investor has registered the investment in the BCRA investment registry (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales) and proves the source of the dividend distribution with audited IFRS financial statements, board minutes, and the corresponding cambio declaration. Practical hurdles include mandatory advanced tax compliance, the absence of automatic tax withholding relief on gross dividend remittances (ordinary dividends remain subject to source tax at applicable rates), documentary requirements for the quarterly tax return, and the need to obtain no tax pending certificate(s) from DIAN and local tax authorities before high-value remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds must be repatriated and channeled through the Colombian foreign exchange market within six (6) months from the date of shipment or, where collection occurs later, from the contractual maturity date, as modified by applicable Banco de la República provisions. The exporter is required to file the Declaración de Cambio (Formulario No. 4 or corresponding electronic form) through an Authorized Foreign Exchange Intermediary, and 100% of the export proceeds must be surrendered or 'canalized' into the Colombian exchange market; these proceeds may be credited in foreign currency to a compensatory or Colombian foreign-currency account with an authorized intermediary, or converted into COP, at the exporter's election, but must be reported to the Banco de la República. Failure to channel within the statutory timeline triggers sanctions under the Estatuto Cambiario, including fines, loss of the right to maintain foreign-currency assets abroad, and potential exchange-control penalties.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Current Account (COP and USD)
Operational Current Account, USD Compensatory Account, Escrow Clearing Account
Operational Account / Restricted-Use Capital Injection Account
Operational Current Account and FX Hedge Collateral Account
Operational Current Account / Trade Finance Clearing Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium feasibility. Offshore digital Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) and payment fintech companies are not authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries under Colombian exchange-control regulations and are generally incompetent to receive declared FX transactions or to perform local clearing through CUD/CB Colombia clearing systems. They may be used strictly as non-banking collection-origination channels for e-commerce receipts, but all settlement must flow into an account held with a Banco de la República-authorised commercial bank. Legal constraints include the prohibition on effecting 'canalización' via unlicensed non-resident third parties, compliance with SFC and UIAF anti-money-laundering circulars, data residency concerns, and the Colombian bank perception of higher third-party-payment risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a high-risk pharma API wholesale distributor, physical presence of the legal representative, compliance officer, and principal shareholder is generally required during initial onboarding in Colombia for corporate account opening. Remote or notarized-online opening is only accepted in exceptional cases for non-high-risk clients; for this entity, the banks will require (i) the legal representative to attend the KYC interview in person at the branch in Bogotá or Medellín, (ii) apostilled or locally legalized corporate documents, (iii) board minutes designating the legal representative and authorized signatories, (iv) proof of the NIT and Chamber of Commerce certificate of existence and legal representation, and (v) physical verification of the registered office. Secondary signatories may attend via video call only where the bank's remote-KYC policy allows, but the primary director must appear physically.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pharmaceutical API wholesale activity categorized as High_Risk_Special_License; high-risk commodity subject to diversion, falsification, and dual-use concerns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid INVIMA sanitary import and distribution license; certificate of good manufacturing practices of the foreign supplier; chain-of-custody documentation for each API product; end-user statements; import permits and customs declarations; batch certificates; and written compliance policies evidencing product traceability and distribution to licensed Colombian pharmacies and laboratories only.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Structure involving a Colombian S.A.S. with 100% non-resident ownership and board of directors outside Colombia
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled incorporation documents and bylaws; notarized board resolutions; certificate of representation from the Chamber of Commerce; full ownership chain to ultimate beneficial owners with passports, personal KYC forms, and publicly verifiable source-of-wealth documentation; Colombian tax registration (NIT), DIAN foreign-investor registration, and the Banco de la República foreign investment registration certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border money flows from or to offshore jurisdictions or related-party pharmaceutical trading hubs
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully executed commercial contracts, commercial invoices, packing lists, B/L or AWB records, insurance certificates, and bank statements showing business rationale; transfer-pricing documentation and organizational chart of the group; written economic-substance explanations; and confirmation that each transaction is annotated with the correct Colombian exchange-control purpose codes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large initial inbound capital injection to a newly incorporated S.A.S. in a sensitive sector
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial projections; board minutes approving the capital contribution; source-of-funds bank statement from the foreign investor's bank; sworn statement of no illegal origin of funds under Colombian law; Banco de la República capital registration form; and the legal entity taxpayer compliance certificate from DIAN.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP (Politically Exposed Person) or adverse-media hits on shareholders or senior management
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent sanctions-screening and adverse-media search reports; UBO declarations; notarized professional reference letters; police/criminal record certificates from countries of residence; approval by the bank's Corporate Compliance Committee; and enhanced ongoing monitoring consent signed by the client.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injections and shareholder loans must be routed exclusively through an Authorized Foreign Exchange Intermediary in compliance with the Colombian foreign-exchange regime. The foreign investor must complete, before or upon remittance, the online Formulario de Registro de Inversión Internacional (FDI registration) through the Banco de la República, using the applicable purpose code for foreign direct investment or 'Suplementaria de aportes a sociedades extranjeras' as appropriate. The wire transfer must be sent by SWIFT MT103 from the foreign investor's bank to the Colombian bank's nostro account with explicit reference to the beneficiary NIT, the Company's Chamber of Commerce number, and the FDI registration code. Supporting documents must include the notarized and apostilled capital increase/share subscription minutes, if any; the NIT certificate; bank information; and the 'Declaración de Cambio' prepared and signed by the legal representative. The Colombian bank will verify the legality of the remittance before crediting the restricted foreign-capital account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for imported APIs and trade-related disbursements must be executed through (i) irrevocable commercial letters of credit (LC) opened with the Colombian bank in favor of the overseas API manufacturer; (ii) SWIFT MT103/MT202 wires for open-account balances, supplier credit repayments, and LC reimbursements; (iii) documentary collections governed by URC 522; or (iv) Bank Payment Obligations (BPO) under the URBPO rules for automated trade finance. Each disbursement requires a Declaración de Cambio (Formulario No. 2 for imports of goods) with the corresponding import declaration and commercial invoice, and must be supported by the invoice, transport document, and customs entry (Declaración de Importación) to satisfy DIAN and Banco de la República validation. Payments to non-resident suppliers in USD are made through local bank clearing in Colombia using the channeling system; cross-border payments must use the Colombian bank's SWIFT network. Sufficient documentary evidence must be retained for a minimum of five years.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards (spot-deferred and outright forwards) denominated in COP/USD entered into with an Authorized Foreign Exchange Intermediary in the local OTC market
Cross-currency swaps (COP/USD plain-vanilla swaps) with Colombian authorized banks for balance-sheet FX exposure hedging
Currency options (COP/USD vanilla options) purchased from authorized intermediaries for cash-flow protection

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) entered into offshore with international banks, provided that the underlying commercial exposure is evidenced and the NDF does not constitute a prohibited speculative exchange transaction under Colombian exchange-control rules
Price-indexed or payment-linked FX swaps embedded in trade finance facilities, subject to Banco de la República form requirements and board approval
FX futures listed on Colombian or recognized foreign exchanges, where used exclusively for hedging of resulting trade receivables and payables

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction over the S.A.S. domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of each year for the immediately preceding calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal after 31 March triggers a 10% late surcharge, increasing to 20% after 30 June. Failure to renew for two consecutive annual terms enables the Cámara de Comercio to administratively cancel the mercantile registration, leading to a strike-off and liquidation of the S.A.S.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' meeting approval of the annual financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Minute Book of the shareholders' meeting; external deposit is required only where a Revisor Fiscal or external auditor has been appointed.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 March each year, within three months after the 31 December fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No direct government late fee applies, but unapproved financial statements have no evidentiary value for corporate or tax purposes, and DIAN may penalize failure to maintain approved accounts as inaccurate records.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Información Exógena – annual third-party transaction information return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing window generally runs from the second half of August through the end of September, staggered by the last two digits of the NIT.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under Article 651 of the Tax Code (Estatuto Tributario), up to 5% of omitted amounts and 1% of incorrectly reported amounts; false or incomplete information may accrue up to 15,000 UVT per infraction. DIAN does not directly invoke strike-off, but persistent non-filing exposes the company to seizure and closure procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of ultimate beneficial owners (RUBF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually before 30 September, subject to the DIAN filing calendar for the relevant year; revised confirmation is required within one month if ownership changes materially.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing or late filing is punishable with a fine of up to 1,500 UVT, RUBF registration suspension, and blocking of tax certificates, refunds or customs clearance. Administrative strike-off is not the primary sanction, but persistent non-filing can lead to intervention by the tax administration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: The S.A.S. must appoint a Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) when required by law or its articles, or when the company exceeds the thresholds established by the Commercial Code and Law 1258/2008: total assets or gross income exceed the equivalent of 3,000 monthly minimum legal wages at year-end; a foreign parent requiring audited group accounts also makes a statutory audit compulsory.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Standards (NIIF) in alignment with IFRS, regulated by Law 1314/2009 and Decree 2420/2015; financial statements are prepared using full NIIF for Grupo 1 entities and NIIF para las Pymes for Grupo 2 entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every S.A.S. must maintain an ultimate beneficial owner register and file an annual UBO confirmation with DIAN before 30 September, stating each direct and indirect shareholder down to the natural-person level. Share transfers must first be recorded in the Register of Members, and the resulting UBO change must be reflected in the annual RUBF filing; a transfer of 5% or more should be reported promptly to avoid administrative fines.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 – USD 1,500 per year for a registered agent, registered office and corporate secretarial package in Bogotá or Medellín.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 – USD 10,000 per year for a certified independent audit or Revisor Fiscal engagement for a mid-sized pharmaceutical API wholesale S.A.S.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (tarifa general del impuesto sobre la renta from Tax Law 2277/2022; applicable tax years 2023-2025; formerly 32%-33%)
